name: Forklift Training
summary:
The forklift operator training program is designed to equip drivers with the essential knowledge and skills to operate forklifts safely and efficiently. Participants will learn about safety regulations during forklift operation, including pre-operation vehicle checks, proper driving techniques, and accident prevention measures. This training not only helps protect the operator but also ensures the safety of those around them and the integrity of assets in the workplace.
